points.description: Describes the setup: new data point is added/considered alongside existing labelled (classified/coloured) data, and the k nearest data points to it are found (e.g., by distance, a neighbourhood/sphere of k points). Pseudo code or equivalent step-wise description of this is given.

Counts the class labels among the k nearest neighbours, picks the class with the maximum vote (majority), and assigns the new data point to that class. Pseudo code or equivalent step-wise description is given.
